• CorMedix announced on October 19, 2026, that in collaboration with its global development partner Mundipharma, the FDA accepted for review the submission of the sNDA for an expanded indication of REZZAYO for the prophylaxis of invasive fungal disease.
Second, the FDA granted Priority Review to the REZZAYO prophylaxis sNDA, with a PDUFA date in the first quarter of 2027.
